### Bug Scenario and Root Cause

The bug scenario involves the `minification-estimator` in Lighthouse incorrectly reporting that a JavaScript file is not minified. The issue arises because the function `hasPunctuatorBefore` in `minification-estimator.js` misidentifies the `/` after `case` as a division operator instead of the start of a regular expression. This causes the code following the regular expression to be treated as a comment, leading to incorrect minification estimation.

### Bug Location and Fix

The bug is located in the `PUNCTUATOR_REGEX` within the `minification-estimator.js` file. The solution involves adding the `case` keyword to the `PUNCTUATOR_REGEX` to correctly identify the regular expression and prevent the misinterpretation of the code as a comment.

### Patch

```javascript
### lighthouse-core/lib/minification-estimator.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
const PUNCTUATOR_REGEX = /(return|{|\(|\[|\.\.\.|;|,|<|>|<=|>=|==|!=|===|!==|\+|-|\*|%|\*\*|\+\+|--|<<|>>|>>>|&|\||\^|!|~|&&|\|\||\?|:|=|\+=|-=|\*=|%=|\*\*=|<<=|>>=|>>>=|&=|\|=|\^=|=>|\/|\/=|\})$/;
=======
const PUNCTUATOR_REGEX = /(return|case|{|\(|\[|\.\.\.|;|,|<|>|<=|>=|==|!=|===|!==|\+|-|\*|%|\*\*|\+\+|--|<<|>>|>>>|&|\||\^|!|~|&&|\|\||\?|:|=|\+=|-=|\*=|%=|\*\*=|<<=|>>=|>>>=|&=|\|=|\^=|=>|\/|\/=|\})$/;
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

This patch adds the `case` keyword to the `PUNCTUATOR_REGEX`, ensuring that the regular expression is correctly identified and the code is not misinterpreted as a comment.
